lines.en: label nikispring7:
scene noonsky
: Cut! Cut! Niki, for the last time, the line is “...and that’s why I always trust Morning Gold.” Not “that’s why I trust no one but myself.”
lines.zh: : 卡！卡！Niki，最后一遍，台词是「……所以我一直都信赖晨光金。」不是「所以我谁都不信，只信自己。」

lines.en: : I think she used a lot more expletives than that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她刚才用的脏话可比这多多了，先生。

lines.en: : I know what the fucking line is! But when the fucking lighting crew can’t get their shit together and keeps shining fucking beams in my eyes, of course I’m going to get the line wrong!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然知道台词是什么！可当那群该死的灯光师连自己的活都干不好，一直把该死的光打在我眼睛上，我当然会念错！

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine. Can we get lighting adjusted so the princess stops complaining?
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧。能不能把灯调一下，好让这位公主别再抱怨了？

lines.en: : Patrice! Shoot him!
lines.zh: : Patrice！开枪打他！

lines.en: : I’m not sure that’s legal, Niki.
lines.zh: : 我不确定那合法，Niki。

lines.en: : Please, just do it anyway. I am literally begging you.
lines.zh: : 拜托，照做就是了。我真的在求你了。

lines.en: : Reset on lighting, please! Positions! We still have to shoot the English version next, so let’s get it on this take!
lines.zh: : 灯光复位，谢谢！各就各位！我们接下来还得拍英文版，所以这一条就过吧！

lines.en: : Morning Gold, Japanese — take 57.
lines.zh: : 《晨光金》日语版——第 57 条。

lines.en: : Hah. Action!
lines.zh: : 哈。开始！

lines.en: scene nikiskinad1
: And that’s why I always trust Morning Gold.
lines.zh: : 所以我一直都信赖晨光金。

lines.en: : Whether I’m preparing for a show or relaxing at home, I can always count on it leaving my skin feeling fresh and rejuvenated and also not fucking cheating on me like my stupid ex-boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 无论是在准备演出，还是在家放松，它总能让我的肌肤感到清新焕新，而且还不像我那个蠢前男友一样他妈的出轨。

lines.en: : Cut! Please tell me we can fix that in post. Please.
lines.zh: : 卡！请告诉我这个后期能修。求你了。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad2
: We might be able to salvage something, but she didn’t really take a breath there. Can we get one more just to be safe?
lines.zh: : 我们也许还能抢救一点，但她刚才那口气没喘上来。保险起见能再来一条吗？

lines.en: : Can you jump off a fucking bridge? We were supposed to be done an hour ago and if I have to hold this smile for one more second I am going to kill every last one of you.
lines.zh: : 你能不能去跳他妈的桥？我们一小时前就该收工了，要是再让我多保持一秒这个微笑，我就把你们一个个全宰了。

lines.en: : Niki, can you-
lines.zh: : Niki，你能不能——

lines.en: scene nikiskinad3
: Fuck off, Patrice! Get back in the cage!
lines.zh: : 滚开，Patrice！滚回笼子里去！

lines.en: : Jesus, Niki. I just wanted to tell you your sister’s here.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Niki。我只是想告诉你，你妹妹来了。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad4
: Oh, yay. What a pleasant surprise. Why?
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶。真是惊喜。为什么来？

lines.en: : I need a fucking cigarette. Take five! And I mean fucking five, people!
lines.zh: : 我需要一根该死的烟。休息五分钟！我说的是他妈的五分钟，各位！

lines.en: : Hey. Sorry to bother you while you’re crashing out on camera, but you’ve been avoiding me everywhere else and it’s left me no choice but to corner you like this.
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉在你当着镜头崩溃的时候打扰你，可你在别的地方一直躲着我，我只剩把你堵在这儿这一条路了。

lines.en: : How did you even find me? I blocked you on literally everything and reaching out to me under those circumstances is in clear violation of section 9A of Nakayama Sister Law.
lines.zh: : 你到底怎么找到我的？我 literally 在所有平台上都拉黑你了，在这种情况下还来找我，明显违反《中山姐妹法》第 9A 条。

lines.en: : You forgot to block me on Skype, so I’d only be violating 9C at best.
lines.zh: : 你忘了在 Skype 上拉黑我，所以我顶多算违反 9C 条。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad5
: Bullshit! Nobody fucking uses Skype anymore! The fact remains that I don’t want to talk to you and now you’re here, ruining everything again!
lines.zh: : 放屁！现在他妈的谁还用 Skype！事实是我根本不想跟你说话，而你现在跑来了，又把一切全毁了！

lines.en: : You sure about that, Nee-chan? Cause it seemed to me like you were in the process of ruining everything yourself by ranting about Akira in front of the cameras.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，姐？因为在我看来，是你自己正忙着毁掉一切——在镜头前大骂 Akira 的就是你。

lines.en: : They’ll fix it in post! I don’t have a therapist and this is the only fucking place I can rant! So fuck off if you’ve got a problem with that.
lines.zh: : 后期会剪掉的！我又没有心理医生，这是他妈的唯一一个能让我发泄的地方！你要是看不惯就滚。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad6
: Just rant to me. I’m still your-
lines.zh: : 那就跟我发泄吧。我还是你的——

lines.en: : You?! You expect me to trust you with literally anything after what you did?! You’re lucky I haven’t told our parents about what happened.
lines.zh: : 你？！在你做了那种事之后，你还指望我信任你哪怕一丁点？！你该庆幸我还没把发生的事告诉爸妈。

lines.en: : Please, can we just talk? It’s about Akira.
lines.zh: : 拜托，我们能谈谈吗？是关于 Akira 的。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad7
: Well, no fucking shit! Can it not wait until I’m done fucking shooting, though?!
lines.zh: : 废话！可就不能等我他妈的拍完再说吗？！

lines.en: : I’ve been here since the fortieth take. This shoot might literally never end based on everything I’ve seen so far.
lines.zh: : 我从第四十条就在这儿了。就我目前看到的，这场拍摄大概永远不会结束。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad8
: I will give you four fucking minutes and that’s it. And every single one of those minutes better be spent apologizing to me or I will kill you too.
lines.zh: : 我给你他妈的四分钟，就这么多。而且每一分钟都最好用来跟我道歉，不然我连你一起宰了。

lines.en: : Fine...deal. Can we go off to the side though so I don’t have to talk about my sex life in front of a bunch of strangers? Assuming you didn’t already tell them everything in the first thirty-nine takes.
lines.zh: : 好……成交。不过我们能不能到旁边去，我不想在一群陌生人面前谈我的性生活？当然，假设你前三十九条里没已经全说了的话。

lines.en: : Three minutes and fifty-five seconds.
lines.zh: : 三分五十五秒。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad9
Let’s stop the clock for a moment and talk about how we got here. How, in this world so full of fish, these two brightly colored anglers managed to hook the same one.
lines.zh: 让我们暂且把时钟停一停，聊聊我们是怎么走到这一步的。在这个满是鱼的世界里，这两个色彩鲜艳的垂钓者，究竟是怎么钓上同一条鱼的。

lines.en: With the same rod, even, given that it became a hand-me-down after the older sister swapped to a net out of desperation, just to wave it around underwater and catch more than she bargained for.
lines.zh: 用的是同一根钓竿——毕竟姐姐绝望之下换成了网，只在水中胡乱挥舞，结果捞上来的比她预想的多得多，这根竿子便成了传下来的旧物。

lines.en: Fish analogies aside, though, this was and forever would be the steepest hill these two will ever have to cross. So steep, in fact, that Niki was now contemplating just pushing Noriko down it.
lines.zh: 不过撇开鱼的比喻不谈，这是、也将永远是这两个人必须翻越的最陡的一座山。陡到 Niki 此刻正考虑，干脆把 Noriko 推下去算了。

lines.en: The spiteful part of her, which was the largest part of all these days, scorned her sister at the moment.
lines.zh: 她身上怨毒的那一部分——这些日子里占比最大的一部分——此刻正在鄙夷她的妹妹。

lines.en: For what had happened this time could not be misconstrued or interpreted as the unwelcome raiding of a closet, but the blatant arson of everything Niki had ever wanted.
lines.zh: 因为这一次发生的事，不可能被曲解或解读成一次不受欢迎的翻柜子，而是对 Niki 曾经想要的一切的公然纵火。

lines.en: And to think that this fire was still blazing just beyond the horizon was infuriating. Her sister still reeked of the smoke.
lines.zh: 而一想到那场火还在地平线之外熊熊燃烧，就令人发狂。她妹妹身上还带着那股烟味。

lines.en: Could she really expect to hear an apology when extinguishing the flames hadn’t even crossed her mind?
lines.zh: 当对方连灭火的念头都未曾闪过，她真的能指望听到一句道歉吗？

lines.en: And even if she did, would it make her feel any better? Would the weight on her shoulders be lifted, or merely replaced with ashes that she’d struggle to relocate after swiping them from her clothes?
lines.zh: 就算听到了，她就会好受些吗？肩上的重量会被卸下，还是只是换成一把灰烬——从衣服上拂下来之后，还得费劲找个地方安放？

lines.en: Stronger than all of that, though, was the disbelief. It was thinking something like this would never actually happen since they were so far apart in age.
lines.zh: 但比这一切都更强烈的，是难以置信。她一直以为，既然两人年龄差那么多，这种事永远不会真的发生。

lines.en: And yet it did.
lines.zh: 可它还是发生了。

lines.en: And yet she saw it.
lines.zh: 可她亲眼看见了。

lines.en: And yet it was burned into her mind.
lines.zh: 可它被烙进了她的脑子。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : If I knew that was going to happen, I never would have come to the beach at all.
lines.zh: : 如果我知道会发生那种事，我根本就不会来海边。

lines.en: : Yeah, you seemed really fucking remorseful while you were having sex with him. Thanks, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你跟他做爱的时候看起来可真是他妈的后悔呢。谢了啊，Noriko。

lines.en: : You wanted it to happen. You’re not sorry at all.
lines.zh: : 你就是想让它发生。你一点都不觉得抱歉。

lines.en: : Of course I wanted it to happen. That doesn’t mean I’m not sorry, though.
lines.zh: : 我当然想让它发生。可这不代表我不觉得抱歉。

lines.en: : But really...I had no idea. It just...
lines.zh: : 但说实话……我完全没料到。只是……

lines.en: : One thing led to another and...all of that led to this.
lines.zh: : 一件事接着一件事，然后……所有这些就变成了现在这样。

lines.en: : Now, things are never going to be the same and we’ll always find it a little harder to look each other in the eye. We’re still sisters, though.
lines.zh: : 现在，一切都不可能回到从前了，我们看向彼此的眼睛时总会更难一些。不过我们还是姐妹。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, yes. We are.
lines.zh: : 很不幸，是的。我们还是。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, huh?
lines.zh: : 很不幸，是吧？

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I’m more pissed off at Akira than I am at you. You’re just a fucking...stupid, hormonal teenager who finally got to fulfill a fucking gross fantasy of hers. So congrats, I guess.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话，我更气的是 Akira，不是你。你只是个该死的……愚蠢的、荷尔蒙过剩的小屁孩，终于实现了她一个该死又恶心的幻想。所以恭喜你吧，我想。

lines.en: : Let’s be real, Nee-chan. We’d be in the same exact place if this happened a few years from now. My age isn’t as important as you’re pretending it is.
lines.zh: : 说实话吧，姐。就算这事儿晚几年发生，我们也会站在完全相同的位置上。我的年龄没你说的那么重要。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad10
: No, maybe it isn’t. But the fact that he literally watched you grow up is. What kind of sick fuck can do that to a girl who used to sit on his lap when she was a baby?
lines.zh: : 不，也许不重要。可他确实是看着你长大的，这一点很重要。什么样的变态，能对一个小时候还坐在他腿上的女孩做出这种事？

lines.en: : The same guy who used to leave our house and then go get molested by an older woman.
lines.zh: : 就是那个从前走出我们家门，然后被一个年长女人性侵的男人。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad11
: Let’s not pretend Akira’s sex life has ever been pure and good, Nee-chan. Chances are you weren’t even the first girl he actually did anything with.
lines.zh: : 别装了，Akira 的性生活从来就没干净、美好过，姐。你大概还不是他第一个真正做过什么的女孩。

lines.en: : First off, I don’t know why you know about that, but I’d prefer if you didn’t just casually bring it up even if you think it’s somehow relevant.
lines.zh: : 首先，我不知道你是怎么知道的，但就算你觉得这有什么关联，我也希望你别随口就提起来。

lines.en: : Which, second, it’s not. Terrible things happening to Akira does not give him an excuse to do terrible things to you or...anyone else since it’s apparently not just you either.
lines.zh: : 其次，它不相关。可怕的事发生在 Akira 身上，并不能给他借口去对你——或者……对别人，做可怕的事，毕竟显然也不止你一个。

lines.en: : He’d say the same thing. It’s not like he thinks he’s a saint. He’s just a profoundly broken man who only knows one way to show his affection since that’s all he was ever taught.
lines.zh: : 他自己也会这么说。他又不觉得自己是圣人。他只是个破碎到骨子里的人，只会用一种方式表达感情，因为别人从来只教过他那一种。

lines.en: : I don’t want it to sound like I’m making excuses for him, though. What you and Sensei have is different than what he has with anybody else. Even me. And he should have put you first.
lines.zh: : 不过我不想听起来像在为他开脱。你跟 Sensei 之间的东西，跟他和其他任何人之间的都不一样。连我也一样。而他本该把你放在第一位。

lines.en: : So let’s just forget about who he’s cheating on you with and just the fact that he’s cheating on you at all.
lines.zh: : 所以我们先别管他跟谁出轨，就只谈他确实出轨了这件事。

lines.en: : Stop emphasizing “cheating” like that. It’s not just my interpretation of what happened. It is what happened.
lines.zh: : 别把「出轨」两个字咬得这么重。这不只是我对这件事的解读。它就是发生了。

lines.en: : Nee-chan...you really thought you were the only one?
lines.zh: : 姐……你真以为你是唯一一个？

lines.en: scene nikiskinad12
: Yes! I did! Does that really make me that fucking crazy?! Was I wrong for thinking he loved me even half as much as I love him?!
lines.zh: : 对！我就是这么想的！这真的让我有那么他妈的疯吗？！我以为他爱我，哪怕只有我爱他的一半——这难道错了吗？！

lines.en: : We lived together and everything...I thought we were going to get married one day.
lines.zh: : 我们都住在一起了，什么都有了……我还以为有一天我们会结婚。

lines.en: : You’ve thought that since you were a kid.
lines.zh: : 你从小就这么想了。

lines.en: : I have! Which is why this hurts so fucking much! Both of you have ripped my fucking heart out, and you didn’t even care enough to stop when I caught you doing it!
lines.zh: : 是啊！所以这才他妈的这么痛！你们两个把我他妈的心活活撕了出来，而我当场抓到你们的时候，你们甚至都懒得停下来！

lines.en: : How am I ever supposed to forgive you guys for that?...
lines.zh: : 这种事，我该怎么原谅你们？……

lines.en: scene nikiskinad13
: I don’t want your forgiveness. And I don’t think Akira does either. I think we both want to feel hated by you since anything else would just make you look weak.
lines.zh: : 我不想要你的原谅。我想 Akira 也不想要。我觉得我们俩都想被你恨着，因为别的任何反应都只会显得你软弱。

lines.en: : Which you’re not, Nee-chan. You’re an idiot, sure. But you’re stronger than anyone I’ve ever met and I know you’re going to get through this somehow too.
lines.zh: : 而你并不软弱，姐。你是个傻瓜，没错。但你比我见过的任何人都坚强，我知道你也会想办法熬过去的。

lines.en: : Maybe...but then what? What comes next? Because I can tell myself I can live without him over and over and over again but we both know I can’t. I’ve already proven that.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……可然后呢？接下来怎么办？因为我可以一遍又一遍地告诉自己，没有他我也能活，可我们俩都知道我做不到。我已经证明过了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to live without him. You can do what I’m doing and just-
lines.zh: : 你不必没有他地活着。你可以像我一样，就——

lines.en: : What, share him? You’re seriously okay with that? It doesn’t gross you the fuck out and make you want to punch him in his stupid fucking idiot face?
lines.zh: : 什么，跟我分享他？你真的能接受？这不会让你恶心得要死、想一拳砸在他那张愚蠢白痴的脸上吗？

lines.en: : You seem to forget that this is what I’ve expected from the beginning. He’s never going to be mine so long as you exist. But even sharing him was always just a dream until recently.
lines.zh: : 你好像忘了，我从一开始就是这么想的。只要你还存在，他就不可能只属于我。但直到最近，连「分享他」都一直只是个梦。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad14
: That said, though, don’t expect me to back off just because you don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，别指望因为你不喜欢我就退让。

lines.en: : I’m not going anywhere so long as he lets me near his side. And if you want to disown me for that, I understand.
lines.zh: : 只要他允许我留在他身边，我就哪儿都不去。如果你要因此跟我断绝关系，我理解。

lines.en: : And it’s not just because I’m in love with him either. It’s because he needs me. He needs us.
lines.zh: : 而且也不只是因为我爱他。而是因为他需要我。他需要我们。

lines.en: : He doesn’t fucking need us. That’s why he left us. And we’re both idiots for chasing him down and expecting to be able to fix him.
lines.zh: : 他才他妈的不需要我们。所以他才离开了我们。而我们两个都是白痴，追着他跑，还指望能把他修好。

lines.en: : If that’s what you believe, fine. You’re wrong, though.
lines.zh: : 如果你非要这么想，随你。可你错了。

lines.en: : He left us because he needs us. And that’s the single most selfless thing he’s ever done.
lines.zh: : 他离开我们，正是因为他需要我们。而那是他这辈子做过的最无私的一件事。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like it’s a long fucking list even if that is true. I can’t suffer anymore, though. If you want to, fine. But I’ve been suffering longer than you’ve been alive and this is just...
lines.zh: : 嗯，就算那是真的，他那张「无私」的清单也不长。可我再也受不了了。你想受，随你。但我受苦的时间比你活着的时间还长，而现在这……

lines.en: : It’s too much now. It all hurts too much.
lines.zh: : 现在太多了。一切都疼得太厉害了。

lines.en: : You say that, but if he stormed in this room right now and begged for you to come back, you’d fold without a second thought.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可要是他现在冲进这间屋子，求你回去，你会想都不想就软下来。

lines.en: : That’s what you did when I brought him here the first time after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟我把他带过来那次，你就是这样的。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad15
: Years and years of “I’m gonna get famous just to piss him off” all destroyed in a matter of seconds. And all it took was one encounter.
lines.zh: : 那么多年的「我要成名，就为了气死他」，几秒钟里全毁了。而这只需要一次重逢。

lines.en: : That was before I watched him fuck my sister. When his greatest betrayal was just leaving me behind.
lines.zh: : 那是在我看着他操了我妹妹之前。那时候他最大的背叛，还只是抛下我。

lines.en: : And this really hurts more than that?
lines.zh: : 而这个真的比那更痛吗？

lines.en: : Would you be happier if he was just...gone again? Because that’s what you’re saying, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 如果他干脆……又消失了，你会更开心吗？因为你说的就是这个意思，不是吗？

lines.en: : I think your four minutes is up, Noriko. Please don’t go out of your way to find me again.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的四分钟到了，Noriko。别再特意来找我。

lines.en: : Nee-chan...you need to talk to him.
lines.zh: : 姐……你得跟他谈谈。

lines.en: : He can talk to me if he wants to talk. But he better be ready to get on his fucking knees and kiss my feet if he does.
lines.zh: : 他想谈，就可以来跟我谈。不过他最好做好准备，跪在他妈的地上亲我的脚。

lines.en: : And even then, I’ll make sure he spends the rest of his life apologizing to me. Every minute of every day because I won’t believe him otherwise.
lines.zh: : 就算那样，我也要让他用余生跟我道歉。每一天的每一分钟，因为否则我不会信他。

lines.en: : You won’t believe him then either. You’ll never believe him again and that’s just the way things are going to be from now on.
lines.zh: : 到那时候你也不会信他。你再也不会相信他了，而从今往后，事情就是这样了。

lines.en: : But you know they aren’t over. You know it doesn’t end like this.
lines.zh: : 可你知道你们没结束。你知道事情不会就这么了结。

lines.en: : Then how does it end?
lines.zh: : 那要怎么了结？

lines.en: : How many more times will I let that douchebag tear me into a million fucking pieces before I can go away for good?
lines.zh: : 在我能永远离开之前，我还要让那个混蛋把我撕成他妈的一百万片多少次？

lines.en: : You can go away for good whenever you want. The problem is you don’t want to. And, despite what you say, you still believe you can fix things deep down.
lines.zh: : 你想永远离开，随时都可以。问题是你不想。而且，不管你嘴上怎么说，你心底还是相信你能把事情修好。

lines.en: : Sorry, but you’re the one trying to get me to fix things right now when I’ve been perfectly complacent handling everything on my own.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可现在明明是你在试图让我去修复关系，而我一个人处理这一切，本来已经足够安于现状了。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad16
: Perfectly complacent? Really? You threatened to kill the director like...ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 足够安于现状？真的吗？你十分钟前还威胁要杀了导演。

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I always threaten to kill that piece of shit. And I’m about one minute away from threatening to kill you too if you don’t fucking leave me alone, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你才是笑话。我一直都威胁要宰了那坨狗屎。而且如果你再他妈的不放过我，我大概再过一分钟就要连你一起威胁了，Noriko。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad17
: You already did. Just before we sat down.
lines.zh: : 你已经说过了。就在我们坐下之前。

lines.en: : Yet, you are still living. There are limits to my mercy, sister.
lines.zh: : 可你还活着。我的仁慈是有极限的，妹妹。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad18
: Nee-chan, what would it take to start repairing things with you and Akira? Because he’s not happy either.
lines.zh: : 姐，要怎样才能让你和 Akira 开始修复关系？因为他也不好过。

lines.en: : Oh? Did he tell you that while he was on top of you?
lines.zh: : 哦？是他压在你身上的时候告诉你的吗？

lines.en: : No. But unlike you, I don’t need him to tell me something to understand it. I just do because that’s the role I’ve decided to fill for him.
lines.zh: : 不是。可不像你，我不需要他开口才明白。我就是懂，因为那是我决定为他扮演的角色。

lines.en: : You have a role to fill too, though. And it’s one I’ll never be able to sub in for no matter how hard I try. So please, just...do both of you a favor and stop this silent treatment already.
lines.zh: : 可你也有一个角色要扮演。而那个角色，无论我多努力都永远无法替补。所以拜托，就……当是帮你们两个，别再这样冷战了。

lines.en: : Noriko, are you asking me to return to a relationship in which my boyfriend is actively having sex with my little sister?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你是在要我回到一段「我男朋友正跟我妹妹上床」的关系里？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. It sounds crazy when you put it that way. But, let’s be real, not a single one of us is all that sane. And I obviously don’t mind sharing with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。你这么一说听着是挺疯的。可说实话，我们三个没一个算正常。而且我显然不介意跟你分享。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad19

: Well, you should. Because even if I hate your fucking guts right now, you are still my sister. And I don’t want you to settle for less than you deserve just because you inherited my attachment issues.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你应该介意。因为就算我现在恨你恨得牙痒，你也还是我妹妹。我不想你因为继承了我的依恋问题，就凑合过低于你应得的生活。

lines.en: : Find someone who will love you and only you. That’s an order. Because if you ever have to go through what I am going through right now, I will find the culprit and kill them too.
lines.zh: : 去找一个只爱你一个人的人。这是命令。因为如果你有朝一日要经历我现在经历的东西，我会把那个罪魁祸首找出来，也一起宰了。

lines.en: : You’re feeling really murderous lately, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你最近杀气很重啊，是不是？

lines.en: : You have no fucking idea.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的一点都不知道。

lines.en: : Can you promise me one thing, at least?
lines.zh: : 至少，你能答应我一件事吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, but say it anyway.
lines.zh: : 大概不能，不过你说吧。

lines.en: : If I can get Sensei to come talk to you, will you at least hear him out? Or will you explode into a bawling mess the second you see his face?
lines.zh: : 如果我能让 Sensei 来跟你谈，你至少会听他把话说完吗？还是一看到他的脸就炸成一团嚎啕大哭的烂泥？

lines.en: : My answer hinges entirely on how many sharp objects are nearby when he approaches me.
lines.zh: : 我的答案完全取决于他靠近我时，附近有多少尖锐物体。

lines.en: : Be serious, please. I want us to go back to normal. Even if I need to orchestrate some sort of grand romantic gesture in order for it to happen.
lines.zh: : 拜托认真点。我想让我们回到从前。就算我得策划一场盛大的浪漫告白才能让这事发生。

lines.en: : Akira? Grand romantic gesture? Come on. Let’s be real.
lines.zh: : Akira？盛大的浪漫告白？得了吧。现实一点。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That’s why I said I’d orchestrate it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。所以我说由我来策划。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad20
: Fine. If you can orchestrate some sort of grand gesture in which he grovels and begs for my forgiveness, I will consider hearing him out. It needs to be grand though.
lines.zh: : 行。如果你真能策划出一场盛大的举动，让他跪地求我原谅，我可以考虑听他说。不过必须够盛大。

lines.en: : The whole world must know that he is submitting to me and that he will do everything I say for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 全世界都必须知道，他在向我臣服，而且他会在永世的每一天里，对我言听计从。

lines.en: : So...you want him to become your slave.
lines.zh: : 所以……你想让他变成你的奴隶。

lines.en: : That sounds about right. Yes.
lines.zh: : 听着差不多。对。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad21
: Okay, people! Break time’s over! Niki, you’re needed back on set! And hopefully less mad!
lines.zh: : 好了，各位！休息时间结束！Niki，片场需要你回来！希望你的火气小一点！

lines.en: : Hah...guess that’s that then.
lines.zh: : 哈……看来就到这儿了。

lines.en: : Can you unblock me on Instagram at least? I keep trying to send you memes and then forgetting you hate me now.
lines.zh: : 至少能在 Instagram 上解除拉黑吗？我老是想给你发表情包，然后才想起来你现在恨我。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it. Now, get lost. I still have work to do. And try not to fuck anyone’s boyfriend on the way out.
lines.zh: : 我会考虑。现在，滚吧。我还有工作要做。还有，出去的路上别再睡别人的男朋友了。

lines.en: : Will do, Nee-chan. Will do.
lines.zh: : 遵命，姐。遵命。

lines.en: scene black
scene nikiskinad22
: Hah...
: So you’re using her as a messenger now, Akira?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在拿她当信使了，Akira？

lines.en: : Was it not enough to break my heart in person? You have to deliver the torment directly to me now?
lines.zh: : 当面伤我的心还不够吗？你现在非要把折磨直接送上门来？

lines.en: scene black
scene nikiskinad23
: Some childhood friend you are...
lines.zh: : 你可真是个好青梅竹马……

lines.en: : And some sucker I am for sitting here expecting you to do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 而我也真是个傻瓜，坐在这儿指望你能做出点什么。

lines.en: : Heh...I’m even talking to myself now.
lines.zh: : 呵……我现在甚至在跟自己说话了。

lines.en: : Look what you’ve done to me...
lines.zh: : 看看你把我弄成了什么样……

lines.en: : I hope you’re suffering too...wherever you are right now.
lines.zh: : 我希望你也在受苦……不管你现在在哪里。

lines.en: scene black
scene nikiskinad24
: Niki! Again! We need you on set! The world does not revolve around you, contrary to what your followers may make you believe!
lines.zh: : Niki！又说一遍！片场需要你！这个世界不是围着你转的，不管你的粉丝让你以为的是什么！

lines.en: : I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : Just give me one more minute, please...
lines.zh: : 再给我一分钟，拜托……

lines.en: : Hah...Sorry. I’ve done all I can.
lines.zh: : 哈……抱歉。我已经尽力了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. We only have a few more shoots left after this one anyway.
lines.zh: : 别在意。反正这条之后我们也没几场要拍了。

lines.en: : She’s still planning on going on hiatus? That’s not just a rumor?
lines.zh: : 她还在打算休止活动？那不只是传闻？

lines.en: : Well, I’m not 100%% sure, but word around the industry is that 567 has already started planning her retirement tour.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不是 100%% 确定，但业内的说法是，567 已经在筹划她的引退巡演了。

lines.en: : Tour? But wouldn’t that mean-
lines.zh: : 巡演？可那不就意味着——

lines.en: : Woah! Who the fuck are you?! How did you get in here?!
lines.zh: : 哇！你他妈的是谁？！你怎么进来的？！

lines.en: : Niki Nakayama.
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama。

lines.en: scene nikiskinad25
scene nikiskinad26
: I have come here to grovel and kiss your feet.
lines.zh: : 我是来跪地求你、亲吻你的脚的。

lines.en: : Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈的在跟我开玩笑吧。
